sys_ux_data_broker_transform.description: This Data Broker script will return a payload of following information about the current user:- 1. Designation - based on group assigned 2. POD Group - based on POD group allocated 3. DL - Name 4. Coach - Name 5. Project - Name 6. Contact Number - 10 digit number 7. Email ID - profile email 8. Current Time Stamp - system time stamp 9. Birth Anniversay - days due for the date 10. Work Anniversary - days due for the date 11. Email Logs - metadata for inbox
sys_ux_data_broker_transform.name: Get Ops User Data
